newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end near highs set late.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end near highs set late.

text.p: Dec 26 - U.S. stock index futures again staged a late-session rally, reaching new session highs after the close of the cash stock market. Traders said activity was thin all day on the first session after the Christmas holiday. Steady bond prices after retailers said Christmas sales may not have been all that strong helped. Some expect further gains Friday ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
